save_xla_ckpt_full: save an MMF checkpoint dict with model and optimizer to a file path using XLA-aware saving
save_xla_ckpt_simple: save a single PyTorch tensor checkpoint to a file using XLA-aware saving on the main process
review_save_xla_ckpt: review the save_xla_ckpt function to understand how it converts model and optimizer tensors to CPU before saving
refactor_save_xla_ckpt: refactor save_xla_ckpt to support additional checkpoint keys beyond model and optimizer for XLA saving
test_save_xla_ckpt: test save_xla_ckpt with a full checkpoint dict containing model and optimizer on the main process
